key_symptoms: Persistent lung infections, Difficulty breathing, Poor growth, Frequent coughing with phlegm, Recurrent sinusitis
treatments: Airway clearance techniques, Medications (bronchodilators, antibiotics), Pancreatic enzyme supplements, CFTR modulators
description: A hereditary disease that affects the lungs and digestive system, causing the body to produce thick and sticky mucus.

key_symptoms: Involuntary movements, Cognitive decline, Mood changes, Difficulty with coordination
treatments: Tetrabenazine for movement disorders, Antidepressants, Physical therapy, Speech therapy
description: A progressive brain disorder that causes uncontrolled movements, emotional problems, and loss of thinking ability.

key_symptoms: Intellectual disability (if untreated), Musty odor, Seizures, Skin rashes, Fair skin and blue eyes
treatments: Phenylalanine-restricted diet, Medical formula, Sapropterin (Kuvan) medication
description: A rare inherited disorder that causes an amino acid called phenylalanine to build up in the body, potentially causing intellectual disability if untreated.

treatments: Pain medications, Hydroxyurea, Blood transfusions, Bone marrow transplant, Voxelotor, Antibiotics
description: A group of inherited red blood cell disorders that affects hemoglobin, causing red blood cells to become sickle-shaped and break down prematurely.

key_symptoms: Progressive loss of mental and physical abilities, Seizures, Vision and hearing loss, Muscle weakness
treatments: Supportive care, Anticonvulsants for seizures, Physical therapy
description: A rare inherited disorder that progressively destroys nerve cells in the brain and spinal cord.

key_symptoms: Excessive bleeding, Easy bruising, Joint pain and swelling, Bleeding in urine or stool
treatments: Clotting factor replacement therapy, Desmopressin (DDAVP), Antifibrinolytics
description: A bleeding disorder in which blood doesn't clot properly due to lack of blood-clotting proteins (clotting factors).

key_symptoms: Intellectual disability, Distinctive facial features, Heart defects, Delayed development
treatments: Early intervention programs, Speech therapy, Physical therapy, Cardiac surgery when needed
description: A genetic disorder caused by the presence of all or part of a third copy of chromosome 21.

key_symptoms: Progressive muscle weakness, Delay in walking, Enlarged calf muscles, Difficulty rising from the floor
treatments: Corticosteroids, Physical therapy, Respiratory support, Exondys 51 for specific mutations
description: A genetic disorder characterized by progressive muscle degeneration and weakness due to alterations of a protein called dystrophin.

key_symptoms: Intellectual disability, Delayed speech, Hyperactivity, Social anxiety, Distinctive facial features
treatments: Educational support, Behavioral therapy, Medications for specific symptoms
description: A genetic condition that causes a range of developmental problems including learning disabilities and cognitive impairment.

treatments: Beta-blockers, Surgery for aortic problems, Vision correction, Physical therapy
description: A genetic disorder that affects the body's connective tissue, which provides strength and flexibility to structures throughout the body.
